page: Google Cloud Platform ct5p-hightpu-4t is a specialized accelerator instance designed for machine learning workloads. It features 208 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 448.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 2.15 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The defining characteristic of this instance is the integration of four Google TPU v5p accelerators, providing a total of 380 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. This hardware configuration targets high-density tensor processing tasks. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance consolidates massive TPU memory and a high vCPU count into a single node, reducing the overhead of multi-node synchronization for moderately sized training and inference tasks.

Given the presence of dedicated Google TPU v5p hardware and the lack of local storage, this instance is tailored for large-scale machine learning workloads. Suitable applications include deep learning model training, large language model fine-tuning, and high-throughput neural network inference.
